summary: Adds globally-toggleable, default-on resizable columns for Dlux data tables. Table headers expose visible dividers backed by contained proportional colgroup widths; narrowed nowrap cells stay within their columns, widths persist per table in the browser, and pointer plus keyboard resizing remains RTL-aware. Inline-safe: Python, template, JavaScript, CSS, i18n, docs, and tests only; no migration.
highlights: Adds layout_config.resizable_table_columns, default on, to System Settings UI & Layout.
Emits data-dlux-table-resize on the base body so operators can disable resize handles globally.
Adds subtle visible dividers and colgroup-backed resize handles to the shared Dlux table template.
Redistributes resized width across other columns to keep tables contained within their parent at every viewport size.
Clips narrowed nowrap body-cell content with an ellipsis instead of allowing values to overlap neighboring columns.
Persists proportional widths per table in browser localStorage and supports double-click reset.
Supports RTL pointer deltas and keyboard resizing from focused resize handles.
Allows individual table classes to opt out with Meta.dlux_resizable_columns = False.
